## Paper

Optimal Auction Design

## World

auction_house

## Institution

Reserve-price / revenue-optimal auction variant.

## Agent type

Private-value bidders and seller mechanism.

## Theoretical benchmark

Myerson-style revenue maximization and reserve-price tradeoff under independent private values.

## Learning setup

Repeated auctions under reserve/no-sale rules with learned bidder strategies.

## Metrics

Seller revenue, allocative efficiency, welfare, no-sale rate, bidder surplus, regret.

## Main result

The paper derives optimal auctions for a wide class of auction design problems, proving that no other auction mechanism can give higher expected utility to the seller.

## What they prove

Formal theorem/proof claims about the optimality of auction mechanisms under specific conditions; the existence of Nash equilibria in auction games

## What they only simulate

Not applicable for this card's thesis use: it is a mechanism-design theory benchmark. This repo implements only simple reserve/no-sale variants and learned bidder responses, not the full optimal-auction design problem.

## What they do NOT test

Repeated learning bidders, neural/MARL policies, fixed discrete bid grids, and this repo's cross-world capability ladder.

## What we need to reproduce

Reserve-price scenarios must report the revenue/efficiency/welfare tradeoff against no-reserve second price.

## How our project differs

The paper characterizes optimal mechanisms. This repo implements simple reserve variants and learned bidder responses, not learned optimal mechanism design.

## Implementation obligations

Reserve/no-sale handling; revenue benchmark; welfare loss accounting; efficiency comparison; regret under reserve.

## Metrics to compare in our repo

second_price_reserve scenario; worlds/auction_house/benchmarks.py; outputs/auction_house_full.

## Failure modes to audit

Calling a reserve setting optimal without distribution assumptions; ignoring welfare/no-sale cost; not comparing to no-reserve baseline.

## Project code comparison

Compare Optimal Auction Design to the Auction House reserve scenario. The repo should frame reserves as a benchmarked design variant, not as full Myerson optimal-auction recovery.
